name: segqc
label: SegQC
description: Automated quality control for vertebra instance segmentations of spine CT: extracts geometric/topological features from a label map, applies an explainable heuristic rule set, and emits JSON + human-readable QC reports.

mounts.name: config-in
mounts.description: Optional QC-config YAML override, resolved by the entry script and forwarded to `segqc run --config <file>` when present; the bundled default config is used otherwise.

mounts.name: reference-in
mounts.description: Optional reference-artifact JSON override, resolved by the entry script and forwarded to `segqc run --reference --reference-artifact <file>` when present.

inputs.name: intensity-mode
inputs.description: Enable Stage-8 intensity/radiomics QC checks (segqc run --intensity).

xnat.name: segqc-session
xnat.label: SegQC vertebra segmentation QC
xnat.description: Runs SegQC against a session's scan and segmentation resources and writes back QC report resources.

external-inputs.name: session
external-inputs.description: Imaging session providing the scan and segmentation resources to QC.

derived-inputs.name: scan-resource
derived-inputs.description: Scan (image) resource on the session, mounted read-only at /input/scan.

derived-inputs.name: seg-resource
derived-inputs.description: Segmentation label-map resource on the session, mounted read-only at /input/seg.

derived-inputs.name: config-resource
derived-inputs.description: Optional QC-config YAML resource on the session, mounted read-only at /input/config; maps to segqc run --config.

derived-inputs.name: reference-resource
derived-inputs.description: Optional reference-artifact JSON resource on the session, mounted read-only at /input/reference; maps to segqc run --reference-artifact.
